card.name: Linking words in seizure and mortality warnings
card.fires_on: The small words "associated" and "of" in fixed warning sentences, right before "with seizures" or "death". Seen in seizure-risk and dementia-psychosis mortality warnings.

modes.label: Seizure warning
modes.description: The word "associated" after "other clinical settings" in the seizure-risk sentence.
modes.example: may increase the risk of seizures occurring in other clinical settings<< associated>> with seizures.

modes.label: Dementia mortality warning
modes.description: The word "of" after "increased risk" in the boxed warning on elderly dementia patients.
modes.example: treated with antipsychotic drugs are at an increased risk<< of>> death.

card.plain: It fires on a linking word inside two stock warning sentences, one about seizures and one about death in elderly dementia patients.
